edges.reason: msg.sender controls sender identity used in blacklist and owner-comparison checks inside _transfer.
transfer() passes _msgSender() as the transfer sender.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as spender for the allowance deduction.
unlock() compares _previousOwner to msg.sender for authorization.
unlock() requires now > _lockTime, making ownership recovery timestamp dependent.
lock() sets _lockTime = now + time, deriving state from block.timestamp.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap swap deadline.
tx.origin is used for the blacklist check and buy-limit check inside _transfer.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth before the actual token transfer completes.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap that transfers control out of the contract.
_transfer sends ETH to the development wallet inside the transfer flow.
sendETHToProjectDevelopment executes an external ETH transfer to a wallet address.
The router swap returns ETH to the contract through the receive() fallback.
A reverting/fallback recipient can re-enter through the payable receive() function.
transfer() delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom() delegates to _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve() delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance() delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance() delegates to _approve.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer with the computed takeFee flag.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for non-excluded accounts.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferToExcluded when the recipient is excluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferFromExcluded when the sender is excluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferBothExcluded when both sides are excluded.
_transferStandard obtains all amounts and fees from _getValues.
_transferToExcluded obtains all amounts and fees from _getValues.
_transferFromExcluded obtains all amounts and fees from _getValues.
_transferBothExcluded obtains all amounts and fees from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the development fee via _takeProjectDevelopment.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
_getValues reads t-space amounts from _getTValues.
_getValues reads r-space amounts from _getRValues.
_getValues reads the current reflection rate from _getRate.
_getRate divides the supplies returned by _getCurrentSupply.
_takeProjectDevelopment converts the t-fee using the current rate.
_tokenTransfer zeroes fees via removeAllFee when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer restores fees via restoreAllFee after a fee-free transfer.
removeAllFee stores and zeroes the _taxFee state variable.
restoreAllFee writes the saved tax fee back into _taxFee.
_taxFee is used in the percentage arithmetic that computes tFee.
_projectDevelopmentFee is used in the percentage arithmetic that computes tProjectDevelopment.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee adds tFee to _tFeeTotal.
_takeProjectDevelopment increases _rOwned of the contract address.
_transferStandard updates _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_getCurrentSupply performs chained subtractions starting from _rTotal.
_setTaxFee writes the owner-supplied tax fee into _taxFee.
_setProjectDevelopmentFee writes the owner-supplied value into _projectDevelopmentFee.
_setProjectDevelopmentWallet replaces the payable development wallet address.
_setNumOfTokensToExchangeForProjectDevelopment updates the swap threshold.
_setMaxTxAmount updates the maximum transaction amount.
setSwapEnabled toggles the swapEnabled state variable.
recoverTokens approves the owner via _approve before transferring.
recoverTokens moves contract tokens to the owner through _transfer.
recoverTokens lets the owner drain arbitrary token amounts held by the contract.
manualSwap calls swapTokensForEth with the whole contract balance.
manualSwapAmount calls swapTokensForEth with the caller-specified amount.
manualSend forwards the contract ETH balance to the development wallet.
manualSwapAndSend first calls manualSwapAmount.
manualSwapAndSend then calls manualSend.
constructor assigns the created Uniswap pair to uniswapV2Pair.
constructor assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router.
lock clears _owner by setting it to address(0).
lock stores the current owner in _previousOwner.
lock sets _lockTime to now + time.
unlock restores ownership from _previousOwner once the timestamp lock expires.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate obtained from _getRate.
balanceOf converts rOwned balances using tokenFromReflection.
balanceOf returns _tOwned for excluded accounts.
deliver obtains rAmount from _getValues.
deliver reduces the total reflections _rTotal.
excludeFromReward pushes the account into the _excluded array.
includeInReward mutates and pops the _excluded array.
excludeFromReward sets _isExcluded for the account.
includeInReward clears _isExcluded for the account.
sender parameter drives the balance updates of _transfer.
recipient parameter drives the balance updates of _transfer.
amount parameter drives the amounts validated inside _transfer.
tokenAmount parameter is swapped by swapTokensForEth.
amount parameter is forwarded by sendETHToProjectDevelopment.
tokenAmount parameter is the amount recovered by recoverTokens.
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner.
time parameter is added to now to set _lockTime.
contractTokenBalance local determines the amount passed to swapTokensForEth.
takeFee local decides whether fees are removed inside _tokenTransfer.
contractETHBalance local is forwarded to sendETHToProjectDevelopment.
path local supplies the Uniswap route used by swapTokensForEth.

normalization_plan.reason: Function parameter of _transfer only; it is an alias for msg.sender and should be folded into the _transfer node.
Function parameter of _transfer with no independent state; merge into the _transfer node.
Function parameter of _transfer used only for validation and balance math; merge into _transfer.
Parameter of swapTokensForEth used solely as the swap input; merge into the swapTokensForEth node.
Parameter of sendETHToProjectDevelopment directly forwarded to the ETH transfer; merge into that node.
Parameter of recoverTokens that selects the drain amount; merge into the recoverTokens node.
Parameter of transferOwnership that becomes _owner; merge into the transferOwnership node.
Parameter of lock used to compute the lock timestamp; merge into the lock node.
Local variable in _transfer that becomes the argument of swapTokensForEth; merge into swapTokensForEth.
Local flag consumed only by _tokenTransfer to toggle fees; merge into _tokenTransfer.
Local variable in _transfer fed to sendETHToProjectDevelopment; merge into that node.
Local swap path array used only by swapTokensForEth; merge into the swapTokensForEth node.
